2105-5144-6633-8330.easyPrerequisites: Combat Celebrant hasn't been exerted this turn.
2105-5144-6633-8330.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
2105-5144-6633-8330.description:
Cast Massimo by paying its mana cost plus commander tax if applicable.
When Massimo enters, it triggers, exiling Ephemerate from your graveyard and giving Massimo the listed ability.
Declare Massimo and Combat Celebrant as attackers, choosing to exert Combat Celebrant as it attacks.
Combat Celebrant triggers, untapping all other creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Deal combat damage with Massimo. Its ability triggers, casting a copy of Ephemerate from exile without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Ephemerate, blinking Combat Celebrant.
Repeat from step 3 each combat phase.

3899-4336-5006-8170.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast a spell using Lurrus this turn if Kobolds of Kher Keep is starting in your graveyard.
3899-4336-5006-8170.description:
Cast Kobolds of Kher Keep by paying {0}.
Flickering Hound triggers, blinking Lurrus.
Resolve the Kobolds of Kher Keep spell. Then, activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Kobolds of Kher Keep, putting a charge counter on Spawning Pit
Repeat.

1003-5006-8095-8170.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast a spell using Lurrus this turn if Phyrexian Walker is starting in your graveyard.
1003-5006-8095-8170.description:
Cast Phyrexian Walker by paying {0}.
Flickering Hound triggers, blinking Lurrus.
Resolve the Phyrexian Walker spell. Then, activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Phyrexian Walker, putting a +1/+1 counter on Hammerhead
Repeat.

985-4927-5078-8171.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Vraska triggers, creating a 1/1 Sculpture Treasure artifact creature token.
Activate the token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

2393-2738-4871-6797.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Tenacious Dead.
When Tenacious Dead dies, it, Sifter of Skulls, and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Sifter of Skulls trigger, creating a creature token.
In response to the remaining trigger, activate Phantom Train by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability from step 5.
Activate two Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Resolve the Tenacious Dead trigger, paying {1}{B} to return it to the battlefield from your graveyard.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability from step 1.
Repeat.

1325-2292-5170-6132.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Metamorphosis Fanatic.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic dies, Kheru Bloodsucker triggers, causing each opponent to lose 2 life and you to gain 2 life.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Kheru Bloodsucker trigger.
Resolve the Kheru Bloodsucker trigger, causing each opponent to lose 2 life and you to gain 2 life.
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Metamorphosis Fanatic from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat.

129-1409-6723-7060.description:
Activate Deadeye Navigator by tapping it, adding {U}.
Kinnan triggers, adding {U}.
Activate Deadeye Navigator by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Deadeye Navigator enters the battlefield, its soulbond ability triggers, repairing it with another creature.
Repeat.

913-1765-2440-7311.description:
Activate Improvised Arsenal by paying {4}{R}, creating a token copy of it.
Chishiro triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each creature you control that shares a creature type with the creature token.
If needed, activate Signpost Scarecrow by paying {2}, adding {R}.
Repeat.
913-1765-2440-7311.notes: The mana cost can be reduced if you control more creatures that share type(s) with the created tokens as the combo begins. You should perform step 4 only if you have no {R} in your mana pool. With infinite mana, the Improvised Arsenal tokens can be attached to creatures you control to make them infinitely large.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

1563-3899-4365-6968.description:
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by paying {1} and removing two charge counters from it, creating two creature tokens
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability twice by sacrificing the tokens, putting two charge counters on Spawning Pit.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

5686-6972-7159.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Arcbound Tracker.
When Arcbound Tracker dies, its modular ability and persist ability trigger.
Resolve the modular trigger, putting Arcbound Tracker's +1/+1 counters on another artifact creature.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning Arcbound Tracker from your graveyard to the battlefield. It will not have a -1/-1 counter on it due to its modular ability.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat.

147-3505-4050.description:
Cast Second Sunrise by paying its mana cost
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Second Sunrise.
Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Second Sunrise
Resolve the Second Sunrise copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

4779-4907-6972.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Grunt by sacrificing Tatterkite
When Tatterkite dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its static effect.
Resolve the Krark-Clan Grunt ability.
Repeat.

2034-3652-5220-6900.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Ornithopter
When Ornithopter dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Ornithopter from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Cast Ornithopter from the top of your library by paying 0 life.
Repeat.

1987-3941-4423.description:
Activate Mystic Sanctuary and Coveted Jewel by tapping them, adding {3}{U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {2}{U}, blinking Mystic Sanctuary and Coveted Jewel.
When Mystic Sanctuary and Coveted Jewel enter untapped, they trigger.
Resolve the Mystic Sanctuary trigger, putting Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Coveted Jewel trigger, causing you to draw three cards, which will cause you to draw Ghostly Flicker.
Repeat.

790-2384-3384-6833.description:
Cast Windfall by paying {2}{U}, causing each player to discard their hand and each opponent to draw cards equal to the greatest number of cards discarded this way, and you to draw twice that number due to Thought Reflection.
Psychosis Crawler triggers for each card you draw, and Scrawling Crawler triggers for each card opponents draw.
Resolve the Psychosis Crawler triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life for each card you drew.
Resolve the Scrawling Crawler triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life for each card they drew.
790-2384-3384-6833.notes: The end result is that each opponent will lose life equal to three times the largest amount of cards a player has in their hand. It is recommended to play this combo when it will be lethal for opponents, as it will give them some card draw in additional to the lifeloss.

215-4010-4068-6723.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Mountain.
215-4010-4068-6723.description:
Cast Farmer Cotton by paying at least {3}{G}{W}
When Farmer Cotton enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating at least three 1/1 Halfling creature tokens and three Food tokens.
Activate Farmer Cotton, three Halflings and three Foods by tapping them, adding {4}{G}{G}{W}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Farmer Cotton from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
215-4010-4068-6723.notes: It is recommended to pay at least {1} additional to start to get infinite untapped tokens. This mana will be recuperated throughout the combo.

193-1124-3604.easyPrerequisites: You control a permanent that enters the battlefield untapped and can tap to produce at least {1}.
193-1124-3604.description:
Activate The Chain Veil by paying {4} and tapping it, allowing you an extra activation of your planeswalkers' abilities this turn.
Activate a permanent by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Cast Aminatou by paying {W}{U}{B}.
When Aminatou enters the battlefield, Cadric triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a token copy of Aminatou.
Activate Aminatou's second loyalty ability by removing a loyalty counter from it, blinking the mana-producing permanent.
Activate a permanent by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Repeat steps 5 and 6 one additional time with the nontoken Aminatou, and one additional time with the token Aminatou.
Activate the token Aminatou's second loyalty ability by removing a loyalty counter from it, blinking the nontoken Aminatou.
Repeat from step 3.
193-1124-3604.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you can blink other permanent(s) instead. If those permanents are legendary, you can copy them via Cadric.

772-5147-6553.easyPrerequisites: Shade's Form attached to Brotherhood Outcast.
772-5147-6553.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Brotherhood Outcast.
When Brotherhood Outcast dies, Shade's Form triggers, returning Brotherhood Outcast from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Brotherhood Outcast enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Shade's Form from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Brotherhood Outcast.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat.

488-1482-1492-4986-5754.notablePrerequisites:
There is at least one additional artifact on the battlefield.
One of either Jeweled Lotus or Welding Jar must be in your hand, with the other in your graveyard.
488-1482-1492-4986-5754.description:
Cast the artifact in your hand by paying {0}.
Teshar triggers, returning Phlage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Phlage enters the battlefield, its first and second abilities and Loran trigger.
Resolve the first Phlage trigger, sacrificing it.
Resolve the second Phlage trigger, dealing 3 damage to any target and causing you to gain 3 life.
Resolve the Loran trigger, returning the other {0} cost artifact from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the spell cast in step 1.
Activate the {0} cost artifact by sacrificing it.
Repeat.

719-4365-4508-5880.description:
Activate Magmaw by paying {1} and sacrificing another nonland permanent, dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Malcolm triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

1987-2104-2187-4423.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four Islands.
1987-2104-2187-4423.description:
Activate Mystic Sanctuary by tapping it, adding {U}.
Cast Temporal Manipulation by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {2}{U}, blinking Mystic Sanctuary and Possessed Skaab.
When Possessed Skaab and Mystic Sanctuary enter the battlefield, they trigger.
Resolve the Possessed Skaab trigger, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Mystic Sanctuary trigger, putting Temporal Manipulation from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Move to your next turn, drawing Temporal Manipulation during your draw step.
Repeat.

643-1724-4304.description:
Cast Sekki by paying {5}{G}{G}{G}.
Sekki enters the battlefield as a Bear due to Maskwood Nexus.
Ayula triggers, causing Sekki to fight a creature you don't control.
Sekki removes a number of +1/+1 counters from it equal to the damage it would've been dealt and creates that many 1/1 Spirit creature tokens, which are Bears due to Maskwood Nexus.
When the Spirit Bear(s) enter the battlefield, Ayula triggers that many times.
If Sekki is on the battlefield, resolve an Ayula trigger, causing Sekki to fight a creature you don't control, and then repeat from step 3.
If Sekki is not on the battlefield, activate Sekki by sacrificing eight Spirits, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield as a Bear with eight +1/+1 counters on it due to Maskwood Nexus.
If Sekki entered the battlefield, Ayula triggers, causing Sekki to fight a creature you don't control.
Repeat from step 3.
643-1724-4304.notes: You may repeat this loop whenever a creature enters the battlefield under your control.

3464-5640-5917.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature that can tap to produce at least {1}.
3464-5640-5917.description:
Activate a mana-producing creature by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Activate The Jolly Balloon Man by paying {1} and tapping it, targeting the mana-producing creature.
Ertha Jo triggers, copying The Jolly Balloon Man's ability, targeting Hyrax Tower Scout.
Resolve the copy of The Jolly Balloon Man's ability, creating a token copy of Hyrax Tower Scout that is a 1/1 Balloon with haste.
When Hyrax Tower Scout enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping The Jolly Balloon Man.
Resolve the Jolly Ballon Man ability from step 2, creating a token copy of the mana-producing creature that is a 1/1 Balloon with haste.
Activate the mana-producing creature token by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Repeat from step 2.

141-5256-5748.notablePrerequisites: You have at least one historic permanent card in your graveyard.
141-5256-5748.description:
Cast What Must Be Done by paying {3}{W}{W}, targeting any historic permanent card in your graveyard.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying {2}{U}{U}.
When Naru Meha enters the battlefield, it triggers, targeting What Must Be Done.
Holding priority, activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Naru Meha, causing target player to mill cards equal to Naru Meha's power.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying What Must Be Done, targeting Naru Meha.
Resolve the copy of What Must Be Done, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield with two +1/+1 counters on it.
Repeat from step 3.

2665-4125-5733.notablePrerequisites:
Progenitor Mimic on the battlefield as a copy of Shipwreck Dowser.
You control at least one Rogue that does not have summoning sickness and cannot be blocked by an opponent.
2665-4125-5733.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using a Rogue.
Cast Notorious Throng for its prowl cost by paying {5}{U}, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Progenitor Mimic triggers, creating a token copy of Shipwreck Dowser.
When the Shipwreck Dowser token enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Notorious Throng from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

301-1142-2034-3644.description:
Activate Lazav by paying {2}, choosing to have it become a copy of Putrid Goblin if it doesn't have a -1/-1 counter on it, or Young Wolf otherwise.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Lazav, adding {C}{C}.
When Lazav dies, if it was a copy of Putrid Goblin, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Otherwise, Lazav's undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Lazav enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to surveil 1.
Repeat.

2444-2837-3000-3297.notablePrerequisites: You control another non-Squirrel creature that has power 3 or greater.
2444-2837-3000-3297.description:
Cast Henry Wu by paying {B}{G}{U}.
When Henry Wu enters the battlefield, its exploit ability triggers.
Holding priority, cast Artificial Evolution by paying {U}, changing all instances of "Human" on Henry Wu to "Squirrel".
Resolve the Henry Wu trigger, causing you to sacrifice another non-Squirrel creature with power 3 or greater.
Henry Wu's second ability triggers, causing you to draw a card and create a 1/1 Squirrel and a 3/1 Dog creature token due to Jinnie Fay and Chatterfang.
When the Squirrel enters the battlefield, its exploit ability triggers, causing you to sacrifice the Dog token.
Repeat from step 5.

1187-2438-2466-2527-2972.notablePrerequisites: Ganax does not have a +1/+1 counter on it.
1187-2438-2466-2527-2972.description:
Activate Honor-Worn Shaku's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Honor-Worn Shaku's second ability by tapping Ganax.
Ganax triggers, causing all Dragons you control to get +2/+0 and undying until end of turn.
Resolve the Honor-Worn Shaku ability, untapping it.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Ganax.
When Ganax dies, its undying ability triggers, returning itself to the battlefield from your graveyard with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Ganax enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability from step 5, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {R}.
Activate Ion Storm by paying {1}{R} and removing a +1/+1 counter from Ganax, dealing two damage to any target.
Repeat.

717-719-4035-4067.description:
Activate Mind over Matter by discarding Blood Speaker.
Bone Miser's first ability triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token that enters the battlefield as a Demon due to Xenograft.
Blood Speaker's second ability triggers, returning itself to your hand from your graveyard.
Resolve the Mind over Matter ability, untapping target artifact, land or creature.
Repeat.

813-1283-1810-4739.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two other creatures.
813-1283-1810-4739.description:
Activate Chromatic Orrery's first ability by tapping it, adding {5}.
Cast Battle Hymn by paying {2}, adding {1} for each creature you control.
Cast Cackling Counterpart by paying {3}, creating a token copy of Scholar of the Ages.
The Scholar of the Ages token enters the battlefield, returning Battle Hymn and Cackling Counterpart from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat from step 2.
Once you have infinite mana, you may return any other instant and/or sorcery cards in your graveyard in place of Battle Hymn.

151-618-908-5056.description:
Pay {U} to Neurok Transmuter to make Kiki-Jiki into an artifact.
Pat {U} to Neurok Transmuter to make Kiki-Jiki blue.
Tap Kiki-Jiki to make a copy of Norritt.
Tap the copy to untap Kiki-Jiki.
Repeat.
Cast To Arms! untapping all your creatures.

1987-2427-3277-3448.description:
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, targeting Stadium Vendors and Izzet Chronarch, blinking them.
When Izzet Chronarch enters the battlefield, return Ghostly Flicker to you hand.
When Stadium Vendors enters the battlefield, add {U}{U}.
Repeat.
